extract.note: left out: the copyright page and the front note on the file set, eBible.org's own texts, for which eBible.org states no license (the rights statement is quoted in the license text); and eBible.org's signing key and the archive's signature (keys.asc, signature.txt.asc), which hold no text of the translation

licenses.text:
Noah Webster Bible, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/engwebster/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this
translation):
> "Noah Webster Bible
The Holy Bible, Containing the Old and New Testaments, in the Common Version, with Amendments of the language by Noah Webster, LL.D.
Public Domain
Language: English
Dialect: archaic American
Translation by: Noah Webster"

Why this is public domain:
First published in 1833 in the United States. Noah Webster died in 1843 (Wikidata), so the work is public domain in the United States (its country of origin, and published long before 1931).

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain
text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source),
and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page
(https://ebible.org/details.php?id=engwebster) and the edition's own files.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)

note: eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside, so a rebuild with the same text still matches.
